verdict.rationale: Name.com's Core API documents endpoints to create DNS records (type, host, value, TTL) and to list them, so programmatic DNS management exists. The pack does not show update or delete endpoints, which leaves the full CRUD cycle and ACME challenge cleanup unproven. Missing for 10: documented update-record and delete-record endpoints, explicit TXT/ACME challenge support, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, DNS records are CRUD-able via a documented API — create, update, and delete records programmatically for automation and ACME challenges

citations.quote: Adds a new DNS record to the specified domain zone. Provide the record type (e.g. A, MX, CNAME), host, value, and TTL.
Lists all DNS records for a specified domain.
